headline: I build <mark>multimodal models</mark> that connect text with other modalities
paragraphs: I 🎤 sing and play the 🎸 guitar and 🥁 drums in a band. In research, I have worked on multimodal models that handle text, music, and images together, and I am now also interested in quantization and computer vision. I believe in the power of steady habits, I enjoy 🍲 eating, 🌅 seeing, and 🎧 listening to good things with good people, and I keep working on communication for better teamwork.
